draft_en.subject: PoE switches behind your iPlus intercom monitors and CCTV kits
draft_en.body:
Hello Vercoma team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 18 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches behind your iPlus IP intercom monitors and CCTV kits, two L2+ managed units (VLAN, IGMP), Marvell-based, CE/RoHS, from single units: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP for apartment-block projects - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $140.1.

One question: which port count do your apartment-block projects typically use per riser - 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
